Question: Who is the mother of Apollo?

Evidence passages from your search for "Apollo mother mythology":
<<<PASSAGES
[P1] Philonis
In Greek mythology Philonis was a daughter of Deioneus and the mother of Philammon and Autolycus by Apollo and Hermes , respectively .

[P2] Antianeira (possibly mother of Idmon)
For other people called Antianeira see Antianeira ( disambiguation ) . In Greek mythology , Antianeira may have been mother of the Argonaut Idmon by the god Apollo . The scholiast on Apollonius Rhodius , however , calls Asteria the mother of Idmon .

[P3] Anchiale (mythology)
In Greek mythology , Anchiale or Ankhiale ( Greek Ἀγχιάλη ) was a Cretan nymph daughter of Japetus . She was the mother of the Dactyls and of Cydnus , who was believed to have founded the town of Anchiale in Cilicia . By the god Apollo she also bare Oaxos .

[P4] Melia (mythology)
In Greek mythology , Melia ( Greek Μελίη ) may refer to the following figures : Melia ( Oceanid ) , a daughter of Oceanus and Tethys , mother , by Apollo , of Tenerus and Ismenus , and/or mother , by Inachus , of Phoroneus and Aegialeus Melia ( nymph ) , a Bithynian nymph , mother , by Poseidon , of Amycus , king of Bebryces Melia , according to Pherecydes , was the daughter of Agenor and sister of Phoenix and Isaie . Together with her sister Isaie , they became the wives of their cousins Danaus and Aegyptus , sons of Belus . The singular form of Meliae , a class of nymphs in Greek mythology Category : Women in Greek mythology Category : Mythological Greek characters

[P5] Antianeira
Antianeira was the name of a number of women in Greek mythology : Antianeira ( possibly mother of Idmon ) , possibly mother of the Argonaut Idmon by the god Apollo Antianeira ( daughter of Menelaus ) , mother of the Argonauts Eurytus and Echiones , whom she bore to the god Hermes Antianeira ( Amazon ) , an Amazon who succeeded Penthesilea as Queen of the Amazons ( see Amazons #Lists )
PASSAGES>>>
